spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: The rule for when -ed is pronounced /ɪd/ is:

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] when the verb ends in a /t/ or /d/ sound
B. [WRONG] when the verb ends in any voiceless consonant
C. [WRONG] when the verb ends in a voiced consonant or vowel
D. [WRONG] when the verb has more than one syllable

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: when the verb ends in any voiceless consonant, when the verb ends in a voiced consonant or vowel, when the verb has more than one syllable
